**The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) president has expressed strong disapproval of FIFA's plans for the World Cup, labeling them as 'unacceptable'.**
## Context / Background
The controversy surrounding FIFA's plans for the World Cup has been escalating, with various football associations and confederations expressing their concerns and disagreements. The AFC president's statement is the latest in a series of criticisms from the football community.
## Tactical Key Points / Stats Table
| Entity | Stance on FIFA's Plan |
| --- | --- |
| AFC | Against |
| UEFA | Critical |
| FIFA | In Favor |
> The AFC president's strong stance against FIFA's plans reflects the growing divide within the football community.
## What's Next?
The controversy is expected to continue, with UEFA holding an emergency meeting to discuss the issue. The outcome of this meeting could have significant implications for the future of the World Cup.
